title: A Postcards for the Aftermath
author: A. M. Underhill
blurb: Oscar Nystrom, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
